title: Mamluk campaigns against Cyprus (1424–1426)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Mamluk campaigns against Cyprus (1424–1426)", at revision 1382136407, opens: "The Mamluk campaigns against Cyprus were a series of military expeditions launched by the Mamluk Sultanate into the Kingdom of Cyprus between 1424 and 1426. As a result of the Mamluk victory in the battle of Khirokitia on 7 July 1426 and the capture of King Janus, Cyprus became a tributary state to the Egyptians." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q22689021, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of Egyptian military expeditions on Cyprus, 1424 to 1426". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
